description: Place an artboard of the active Illustrator document on a page of the active InDesign document, linked to the .ai file so edits in Illustrator update the layout when the link is updated. The Illustrator document must already be saved as .ai (with "Create PDF Compatible File", Illustrator's default). Position and width are millimetres from the InDesign page's top-left corner

crop.description: Which bounds of the artboard to place: art (the artwork itself, default), trim (the artboard), bleed, media, or content

saveFirst.description: Save unsaved changes in the Illustrator document first, so the layout gets the current artwork. Default true

width.description: Scale the artwork proportionally to this width in mm. Default: placed at 100%

x.description: mm from the page's left edge. Default 10

y.description: mm from the page's top edge. Default 10

name: place_illustrator_artwork_in_indesign
title: Place Illustrator Artwork In InDesign
